lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, following the anatomical curvature of the flank with a higher density of smaller spots concentrated anteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a semi-regular grid of high-intensity nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift from high-intensity highlights on the dorsal-facing edge to low-intensity shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-10 high-luminance blobs distributed across the lateral surface, with higher spacing relative to the flank pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, elongated high-luminance feature (remora) is attached to the ventral-lateral area just posterior to the branchial region.
